`Fixes #368 and releases v0.36.3.

- \`resolveToolInput\` (\`src/tool/input.ts\`) decodes a \`params\` string that is a JSON string literal for every declared input, so a program with a string input gets real line breaks instead of quotes and \`\\n\` escapes. A quoted string that is not valid JSON passes through unchanged. This is the patch from the issue, plus tests for an unannotated input with surrounding whitespace and for a lone quote. \`docs/reference.md\` describes the new behavior.
- Release commit: adds a \
